Money exceptions

Charges and payment states that need a person, most urgent first. Dates are Brisbane time. Nothing here moves money.

Super fast renders

Captures an account paid A$29 on the website to have rendered first, on the fastest GPU in Australia, and ready for review within 30 minutes of the upload finishing, any day, any time. Open ones are listed soonest due first, then any missed one whose refund has not gone through. A missed one is refunded automatically: the A$29, or the bonus render returned. The capture queue shows them as Super fast. Dates are Brisbane time. Read-only.

Hosted walkthroughs

Every released walkthrough, due soon first: hosting that ends within 60 days, or has ended, while the plan is not active. A date passing switches nothing off. Record extension only moves the date later, keeps an audit row and takes no payment.

Corrections

A correction is a new package for a walkthrough the account already has. Recorded here, it stays one walkthrough: once that walkthrough has been accepted, approving the new version uses nothing from the account's allowance, and its link and embed move to the new version. A package not recorded here counts as a walkthrough of its own.

Whole-home count

1 walkthrough is one visit to the interior rooms of one home. A home with 5 or more bedrooms, a second dwelling or more than 350 m² of floor area counts as 2: the account declares it when it adds the listing, and the count locks when capture starts. A correction here sets the declared facts with a reference and an audit row, also after capture started; a walkthrough already accepted keeps the units it used.
